content.title: Trading Hours for the World’s Major Stock Exchanges
content.text: Key Takeaways Most of the world’s stock exchanges are open during regular business hours in local time. The NYSE and Nasdaq's regular trading hours are Monday through Friday, 9:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. Eastern Time (ET). Trades entered through an online broker platform when the exchange is closed are executed at the open unless otherwise indicated. North American exchanges closely match the New York timeframe. A stock market exchange is a marketplace where stocks are bought and sold during trading hours. It functions as an entity to ensure orderly trading and efficient dissemination of price quotes for companies listed on the exchange. Trading is generally conducted Monday through Friday, but exceptions may occur, such as market closures, observing market holidays, or Market-Wide Circuit Breakers, which can temporarily halt trading due to unprecedented volatility. Investors can access most markets and exchanges worldwide through the best online broker platforms. Time matters when you're trading. Westend61 / Getty Images Trading Hours on Holidays Holidays depend on the local calendar, so they differ for every location. The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) closes on July 4 for U.S. Independence Day. The Singapore Stock Exchange closes for the Chinese New Year. Some exchanges close for half a day from time to time. The NYSE is open only until 1 p.m. on Christmas Eve, and the London Stock Exchange has a two-minute break at noon daily. Note Most exchanges operate Monday through Friday, but the Saudi Exchange is open from Sunday to Thursday. Trading Hours on North American Exchanges Trading in North America is generally based on the Eastern time zone, no matter where the exchange is located. The headquarters of the trading exchanges are in New York City, Toronto, and Mexico City. The westernmost time zone is Mexico City, with the Mexican Stock Exchange (BMV) trading within business hours of Central Standard Time (CST). However, the hours mirror those of the NYSE, so trading is generally open during the same timeframe, even though the BMV trades on CST. Regular trading hours for the NYSE and Nasdaq are Monday through Friday from 9:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. An alternative for investors in foreign stocks is to trade American depositary receipts (ADRs) that trade on U.S. exchanges and in U.S. dollars. Trading Hours in Asia and the Middle East There are 11 time zones across Asia and its immediate neighbors, but they roughly synchronize their exchange hours to create a good deal of overlap for trade and liquidity. Some Asian markets take a break for lunch, including the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE) and the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE/TYO). The Shanghai Stock Exchange has numerous market holidays each year, including an extended hiatus for the Chinese New Year. Important India’s stock market capitalization surpassed Hong Kong’s for the first time on Jan. 22, 2024. This made India the fourth-largest equity market globally at the time. The combined value of shares reached $4.33 trillion on the exchanges in India, beating the $4.29 trillion in Hong Kong, according to data compiled by Bloomberg. Trading Hours in the U.K. and Europe Like Asia, Europe has many individual exchanges. The largest stock exchange organization in Europe is Euronext, a pan-European exchange that operates in seven countries and has its headquarters in Amsterdam. Trading Hours in South America The largest exchange in South America is in São Paulo, Brazil: B3 Brazil Bolsa Balcão. The exchange trades from 10 a.m. to 4:55 p.m., and it trades at approximately the same hours as the NYSE and Nasdaq because São Paulo is one hour ahead of New York City. Stocks, commodities, and options are traded on the São Paulo exchange. Trading Hours in Africa The largest stock exchange in Africa is in Johannesburg, South Africa. However, there are smaller exchanges in Egypt, Mauritius, and Nigeria. The Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) acquired the South Africa Futures Exchange and the Bond Exchange of South Africa, so all those assets are traded on the JSE. The Johannesburg exchange is open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. South African Standard Time (SAST) with no lunch break. Trading Hours in Australia/Oceania The Sydney-based Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) is roughly the same size as the South African exchange. The ASX merged with the Sydney Futures Exchange in 2006. Bonds and derivatives are also traded on the ASX. The market opens later than most at 10 a.m. local time, and there's no lunch break. What's the Difference Between a Stock Exchange and the Stock Market? A stock exchange is a marketplace or infrastructure that facilitates equity trading. The exchange is founded and managed by a corporation, either private or public. It allows companies to list their stocks in its marketplace.The term “stock market” refers more generally to stocks or a group of stocks in a particular region, industry, or sector. Which Major Stock Exchanges Are Closed During Lunch? The major stock exchanges with an official lunch close are the Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE/TYO), the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (SZSE), and the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong (HKG).The London Stock Exchange (LSE) has a two-minute break at noon. However, its traders don’t eat that fast. The mini-break protects institutional traders from high-frequency traders whose split-second transactions can skew prices. What Times Are the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and the Nasdaq Open? The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and the Nasdaq are both open from 9:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. Eastern time. Both publish annual calendars of their holidays and half days. What Is a Circuit Breaker in the Stock Market? A circuit breaker temporarily stops all trading activity on a specific stock exchange that issued the halt. Circuit breakers are a rare phenomenon generally caused by extreme volatility; however, worldwide events can also cause one. The Bottom Line Most global stock exchanges are open during business hours, Monday through Friday, except the Saudi stock exchange, which is open Sunday through Thursday.
